name: lw_49950
statement: (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a + b = 1) : x * Real.log x + y * Real.log y ≤ a * Real.log (a * x) + b * Real.log (b * y)
closed: ∀ (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a + b = 1), x * Real.log x + y * Real.log y ≤ a * Real.log (a * x) + b * Real.log (b * y)
informal: Show that $x \ln x$ is convex on the positive real numbers
type: ∀ (x y : ℝ), 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ (a b : ℝ), a + b = 1 → x * Real.log x + y * Real.log y ≤ a * Real.log (a * x) + b * Real.log (b * y)
